bio_en: Gaspar Ipekian was one of the ARF's most energetic intellectuals and a founding member of the Hamazkayin cultural society, working for years with Levon Shant and Nikol Aghbalian and serving as secretary of its central board and head of its publishing. Known for literary works, political articles and translations, he played political roles from Persia to Lebanon. A 1907 photograph shows him in Lausanne with Komitas, Arshak Chobanian and Ruben Sevak. He lived in Beirut for about a quarter of a century and died there of heart disease in March 1952.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Not the same as Gaspar of #490 (Persia) - check.
